fixes.title: Pastes containing a web image inserted nothing at all
fixes.problem: Pasting any content that included an http(s) image, such as a web article with a photo or editor content with an uploaded image, inserted nothing. All the text, lists, tables and the image were silently dropped.
fixes.cause: The `summernote.paste` handler returned early whenever `/]+src=["']https?:\/\//i` matched the clipboard HTML. The comment said this deferred to `onImageUpload`, but that callback only fires for image files, never for `` tags in HTML. Because `e.preventDefault()` had already run, nothing was inserted.
fixes.change: The change removes the early return, so clipboard HTML with http(s) images now goes through `buildInsertNodes` and `cleanHtml`. `cleanHtml` keeps loadable http(s) and `data:` images when images are allowed.

image manipulation › images nested inside pasted tables and lists are retained
mixed-content pastes › web article with image: text before and after the image, list and link all retained
mixed-content pastes › image directly before a table, table trailing: both retained, caret below the table
mixed-content pastes › multiple tables and images in one paste: all retained in document order
RTE to RTE copy/paste › content containing an uploaded (https) image pastes fully — text and image
web page paste › article containing an https image pastes fully — text, link and image
fixes.shot: mixed-content pastes › web article with image: text before and after the image, list and link all retained

fixes.title: Pasted content with embedded base64 images never saved
fixes.problem: Modern Word embeds images as data URIs in clipboard HTML. After such a paste the content looked correct but was never saved to Appian, and saving waited forever.
fixes.cause: Upload to the Connected System (`uploadBase64Img`) only ran from `onImageUpload` and `handleImagePasteFromFile`, which handle image files. Base64 `` tags inside pasted HTML had no upload path, and `setAppianValue` refuses to save while `doesBase64ImageExist()` is true. Separately, `doesBase64ImageExist` used `/\
fixes.change: After inserting a paste, the handler runs `uploadEditorImage` on every `img` in `.note-editable`. This uses the same loading-marker, upload and src-swap flow as `onImageUpload`, and skips images already marked `loading`. `doesBase64ImageExist` now uses `/<img\b[^>]*\ssrc=["']?data:/i`, so it matches `src` in any position and with any quoting. `isImageNewBase64` also drops the stateful `g` flag.
tests: mixed-content pastes › Word section with text, embedded image, list and table SAVES to Appian
image manipulation › base64 image in pasted HTML: save waits for the upload, then goes through
RTE to RTE copy/paste › base64 image embedded in copied RTE content is retained and uploaded
paste robustness › pasting text while an image upload is in flight: both survive, save settles once
fixes.shot: mixed-content pastes › Word section with text, embedded image, list and table SAVES to Appian

fixes.title: Multi-line plain text pasted as one fused line
fixes.problem: Pasting multi-line plain text (from Notepad, a terminal or a PDF viewer) joined all the lines into one run of text. Paragraph and bullet structure was lost, and text after the caret could end up in the wrong place.
fixes.cause:
Plain-text clipboard content went straight into `DOMParser`, which produced a single text node. Its newlines were never turned into `
`. A bare sequence of text and `
` nodes would also have broken `insertNode`'s caret placement.
fixes.change:
When the clipboard content does not start with `<`, it now goes through `cleanHtml(clipboardHtml, true)`, whose raw-text branch turns newlines into `
`. If the result contains a `
`, it is wrapped in one `

` so it inserts as a single block. Single-line text stays unwrapped and inserts inline.

paste at cursor position › multi-line plain text pasted mid-paragraph: following text pushed below, caret before it
RTE to RTE copy/paste › plain-text paste converts newlines to line breaks
PDF paste › multi-paragraph text: all paragraphs retained with line breaks
PDF paste › bulleted list: bullet glyphs and every item retained on separate lines
fixes.shot: paste at cursor position › multi-line plain text: spacing correct AND caret ends at the end of the pasted text

fixes.title: Word pastes gained spurious line breaks mid-sentence
fixes.problem: Text pasted from Word was broken onto new lines in the middle of sentences. Each Shift+Enter hard return also became two line breaks.
fixes.cause:
In `cleanHtml`'s paste-HTML branch, every remaining `\n` was turned into `
`. Newlines that were only source formatting (between inline spans, or after a `
`) therefore became visible breaks. The same branch also deleted all whitespace between tags (`/>\s+
fixes.change: In the paste-HTML branch, `cleanHtml` now turns every CR/LF into a space, because real breaks arrive as tags. `buildInsertNodes` keeps whitespace text nodes between inline elements. It still drops whitespace-only nodes next to a block element (`isBlockElement`), since those break `insertNode`. The Word list-marker cleanup now also strips lone CRs (`/[\r\n]+/g`).

fixes.title: Copied images and Excel/Word ranges pasted the image twice
fixes.problem: Some copies put both HTML and an image file on the clipboard: copying an image from a PDF viewer, Excel ranges carrying a bitmap snapshot, or Outlook text with an inline image. Pasting these inserted the image twice, or added a picture of the table next to the real table.
fixes.cause: Summernote's own clipboard-file insertion (`allowClipboardImagePasting`, on by default) inserted every image file through `onImageUpload`. The HTML flavor was inserted as well, whether or not it already contained that content.
fixes.change: The change sets `allowClipboardImagePasting: false` and makes the paste handler the only place that decides about files. If the HTML has no visible text, the files are inserted through `insertImagesOrCallback`. If there is text plus an unloadable image reference (`UNLOADABLE_IMG_REGEX`, e.g. Outlook's `cid:`), the files are inserted and the text is also pasted. In every other case the file is a redundant snapshot and is ignored.

fixes.title: Pasting a copied document file inserted a broken image
fixes.problem: Pasting a file copied in the file explorer, such as a PDF, inserted a broken image built from the document's data, which was then uploaded. When a PDF and an image were copied together, both were inserted.
fixes.cause: Clipboard files were handed to the image insertion path without checking their type, so non-image files went through `FileReader` and were inserted as ``.
fixes.change: The paste handler now keeps only files whose `type` matches `/^image\//i` (`clipboardImageFiles`) before deciding what to insert. Non-image files are ignored.

fixes.title: Unloadable image references were pasted and saved as broken images
fixes.problem: Images from Word (`file:///...clip_image002.png`), Excel charts (temp files) and pages using relative URLs were pasted and saved to Appian as permanently broken images.
fixes.cause: `cleanHtml` kept any allowed `` whatever its `src`, including local temp-file paths and relative URLs that cannot load in another user's browser.
fixes.change: A new paste-time-only step in `cleanHtml` (Step 6.5, gated on `isPartialHtml`) removes `` tags whose `src` is not `http(s):` or `data:`. Surrounding content is kept. Stored content is not changed when it is rendered or saved.

fixes.shot: MS Word paste › embedded image: surrounding text retained; dead file:/// reference does not reach Appian

fixes.title: Script and style contents leaked into pasted text
fixes.problem: Pasting HTML with a `<script>` or `<style>` block inserted the code itself as visible text (for example `window.__pwned = true;`). Content after the script could also be lost.
fixes.cause: `cleanHtml`'s Step 2 tag allowlist removed only the disallowed tags themselves. The text inside `script`, `style`, `iframe` and similar elements was left behind.
fixes.change: A new Step 0 in `cleanHtml` first removes these tags together with their contents (`DANGEROUS_TAGS_PATTERN`), then removes any lone opening or self-closing forms (`DANGEROUS_TAGS_SELF_CLOSING_PATTERN`). This covers `script`, `style`, `iframe`, `object`, `embed` and `noscript`. The paste handler also uses `DANGEROUS_TAGS_PATTERN` when it measures visible clipboard text.
tests: paste sanitization › script tags are removed with their contents and never execute
fixes.shot: paste sanitization › script tags are removed with their contents and never execute

fixes.title: Unquoted and single-quoted attributes bypassed the attribute allowlist
fixes.problem: Attributes written without quotes (as Word emits them, e.g. `border=1 cellspacing=0`) or in single quotes were not filtered on paste, so disallowed attributes stayed in the saved HTML.
fixes.cause: In `cleanHtml`, the Step 3 attribute regex `/([\w-]+)="[^"]+?"/g` only matched double-quoted, non-empty values. The Step 4 style lookahead only stopped at a `"`.
fixes.change: Step 3 now matches double-quoted, single-quoted and unquoted values (`/([\w-]+)=(?:"[^"]*"|'[^']*'|[^\s>]+)/g`), so all of them go through `ALLOWED_ATTRIBUTES`. The Step 4 style lookahead also accepts `'` as the closing quote.

fixes.title: Code blocks copied from web pages lost their line breaks
fixes.problem: Pasting a code block from a web page ran its lines together with the text before it (for example `introconst a = 1;`) and dropped later lines.
fixes.cause:
`
` is not an allowed tag, so after cleaning its contents became bare text and `
` at the top level of the paste. That sequence breaks `insertNode`'s caret placement, so lines after the first were lost.
fixes.change:
In the paste-HTML branch, before newlines are flattened, `cleanHtml` turns newlines inside each `
` block into `
` and wraps the block in `
`. The lines are then inserted together as a single paragraph.

fixes.title: Inline content after a pasted table landed inside its last cell
fixes.problem: When one paste contained a table followed by inline content (an image or text), that content ended up inside the table's last cell instead of after the table, which scrambled the document order.
fixes.cause: After inserting a table, `insertNode` leaves the caret in the last cell. A range set just after the table is pulled back into that cell, so the next inline node from the same paste was inserted there.
fixes.change:
In the insertion loop, when a table is followed by a non-block node, the handler reuses or creates an empty `


` after the table. It puts the selection inside that paragraph and calls `editor.setLastRange`, because `insertNode` reads `lastRange` rather than the live selection.
tests: mixed-content pastes › table pasted INTO existing text with an image following it keeps document order
fixes.shot: mixed-content pastes › table pasted INTO existing text with an image following it keeps document order

fixes.title: Pastes left stray blank lines behind
fixes.problem: Pressing Enter and then pasting left an extra empty line where the caret had been. Each repeated paste also added another empty paragraph at the bottom of the editor.
fixes.cause:
Upstream did nothing about the empty `


` at the caret, or about the new trailing empty paragraphs Summernote leaves when it inserts blocks.
fixes.change: Before inserting, the handler records the empty caret paragraph (`findCaretEmptyParagraph`) and the blank paragraphs already at the end of the editor (`snapshotTrailingEmptyParagraphs`). Afterwards, `removePasteArtifacts` removes the caret paragraph if it is still blank and holds no media. It also removes only new trailing empty paragraphs and keeps the ones that existed before the paste.

paste empty-paragraph cleanup › repeated pastes do not accumulate trailing empty paragraphs
fixes.shot: paste empty-paragraph cleanup › Enter-then-paste leaves no stray empty paragraph at the caret

fixes.title: Pasted tables left two blank lines and a misplaced caret
fixes.problem: A table pasted into the middle of text was followed by two blank lines instead of one. After pasting a table at the end, the caret appeared stuck against the table until the user typed.
fixes.cause:
After a trailing table, the handler always inserted a new `


`, even when splitting the destination paragraph had already left an empty one after the table. It also left the selection after the `
`, where browsers draw the caret against the table's edge.
fixes.change: If the node after the trailing table is already an empty paragraph (`isEmptyParagraph`), the handler reuses it instead of adding another. It then collapses the selection to offset 0 of that paragraph, so the caret shows on the blank line below the table.

RTE to RTE copy/paste › caret lands on the blank line below a pasted table, ready to type
fixes.shot: paste at cursor position › table pasted mid-content leaves exactly one blank line before the following text

fixes.title: Screenshot paste inserted images even when images were disallowed
fixes.problem: With `allowImages` set to false, pasting a screenshot still inserted the image and uploaded it.
fixes.cause: `allowImages` only controlled the toolbar picture button and HTML-paste cleaning. `onImageUpload` inserted and uploaded any image file it received without checking it.
fixes.change: `onImageUpload` now returns immediately when `window.allowImages` is false, so every route into it respects the parameter.
tests: image manipulation › screenshot paste is blocked when allowImages is false
fixes.shot: image manipulation › screenshot paste is blocked when allowImages is false

fixes.title: Failed image upload replaced the image with a broken one
fixes.problem: When the Connected System upload failed, the pasted or uploaded image became broken (`src="undefined"`) and could not be retried. Without a connected system, the upload path threw an error.
fixes.cause: `onImageUpload` and `handleImagePasteFromFile` set `src` to whatever `uploadBase64Img` resolved to. That value is `undefined` on failure. Both also called `.then` on the non-promise that `uploadBase64Img` returns when there is no connected system.
fixes.change: All upload callers now use `uploadEditorImage`. It only swaps `src` when a source comes back, otherwise it keeps the `data:` URI so the next paste can retry the upload. It also checks for a non-promise return before calling `.then`.

fixes.title: Strikethrough copied from web pages was lost
fixes.problem: Strikethrough text copied from web pages (for example a crossed-out price) pasted as plain text with no strikethrough.
fixes.cause: `ALLOWED_TAGS` contained only the legacy `strike` tag, not the `<s>` tag that modern pages use, so `cleanHtml` removed `<s>`.
tests: web page paste › modern strikethrough (<s>) copied from a web page is retained
RTE to RTE copy/paste › formatting gauntlet: every format alone and in stacked combinations survives, and saves
fixes.shot: web page paste › modern strikethrough (<s>) copied from a web page is retained

fixes.title: Content-too-big error flashed during every image upload
fixes.problem: While an image was uploading, the maxSize validation error appeared briefly and then disappeared once the upload finished.
fixes.cause: `validate` measured `getEditorContents().length`, which included the uploading image's large base64 data URI. That data is never saved.
fixes.change: `validate` now replaces `src="data:..."` and `src='data:...'` with `src=""` before comparing against `maxSize`. The measurement stays inside the `!isReadOnly()` guard because `getEditorContents` throws in read-only mode.
tests: editor lifecycle › maxSize validation does not flash while an image uploads

fixes.title: Multi-line HTML comments survived paste cleaning
fixes.problem: HTML comments that spanned more than one line, such as Word's conditional comments, were not removed when content was cleaned.
fixes.cause: `cleanHtml` Step 7 used `/<!--.*?-->/g`. Because `.` does not match newlines, comments spanning several lines were not removed.

otherChanges: Moved the inline paste logic into named helpers (`buildInsertNodes`, `isBlockElement`, `hasBlankText`, `isEmptyParagraph`, `findCaretEmptyParagraph`, `snapshotTrailingEmptyParagraphs`, `removePasteArtifacts`) and moved `BLOCK_LEVEL_REGEX` and the dangerous-tag regexes to module-level constants.
Exported `uploadEditorImage` through `browserScriptTransform.js` so unit tests can reach it.
Added unit test file `cleanHtml.imageSources.test.js` (file:///, src-less and javascript: images are removed).
Added unit test file `pastePlainTextLineBreaks.test.js`, which calls the real paste handler: plain text, whitespace filtering, clipboard-file decisions, `<pre>` handling and base64 upload/retry.
Added `doesBase64ImageExist` attribute-order cases and `uploadEditorImage` success, failure and no-connected-system tests to `pasteHandling.test.js`.

Changed existing `cleanHtml` unit tests to expect the new behavior: newline becomes a space, script/style are stripped with their contents, `<s>` is kept, and the attribute-regex edge case has a new expected value.
Ran Prettier on the changed files and tightened comments.
